Maya K: heads-up — saw a regression on longctx runs when using INT8 KV page compression. profiling attached.
Maya K: repro: large-chat load (seq 32k), model:redwood-7b-quant, kernel-policy: auto
Maya K: observed: KV resident mem -1.9GB vs bf16, but rerank eval +3.2% ppl (worse). p95 latency +12ms.
Raj P: can you paste the perf numbers? where's the trace?
Maya K: paste: ```
run: batch=8, seq=32k, warm=2
baseline (bf16): kv_mem=14.2GB, p95=38ms, ppl=12.1
int8-compact: kv_mem=12.3GB, p95=50ms, ppl=12.5
evicts/sec: baseline=0.2, int8=3.6
```
Lina W: evicts/sec jump is huge. looks like more fragmentation / warmup misses. is the int8 page packing changing slot alignment?
Eli G: int8 packing can change slot widths; we previously saw slot holes when compaction didn't run. kernel fallback (cuBLAS -> fused-attn slow-path) might be causing extra KV writes.
Maya K: also saw lots of small host spills during longctx; nvml counters spike with page-faults. infra-bot log excerpt below.
infra-bot: [AUTO] gpu-3 vm_faults=214, eviction-trigger=threshold-3, sweep-kernel=slow-path, time=2026-11-03T14:02:13Z
Raj P: quick test: force bf16 attention kernel while keeping int8 KV layout (kernel_override=bf16_attn). if p95 drops -> kernel selection is main culprit.
Lina W: also try increasing max_batch_tokens and reduce micro-batching — micro batches cause more KV churn on our traces.
Eli G: hypothesis: int8 reduces per-slot size but increases variance in residency. coalescing heuristics assume near-constant slot widths; quantized slots produce uneven holes so compaction doesn't trigger. result = fragmentation + more evictions.
Maya K: proposal: add KV frag telemetry (free_segments_count, avg_hole_bytes), run async compaction when avg_hole_bytes > 10% of slab, and add a fallback to bf16 kernel on sustained p95 spikes. small canary: 5% traffic int8+bf16-ker override.
Raj P: I'll add instrumentation (free_segments_count, avg_hole_bytes, evict_rate) and expose dashboard.
Lina W: I'll add canary route + traffic manager config; alert on ppl delta > 1.5% and evict_rate > 1/s.
Eli G: add long-run perf test: longctx seq=32k, 10k iterations, assert evicts/sec < 1 and ppl delta < 1.0% vs bf16 baseline. also record kernel switch counts.
Maya K: sounds good. minor note: check kernel selection heuristics — if sequence-length distribution skews, we should bias toward bf16-attn for large sequences.
Raj P: ETA: instrumentation in staging by EOD, dashboard by tomorrow.
Lina W: canary PR this morning.
Eli G: I'll prototype compaction trigger and a small allocator patch to reduce hole variance.
Maya K: thanks all. triage follow-up in #eng-runtime tomorrow. :thumbsup:
